name: rollbar-triage
description: Triages Rollbar errors into an actionable work list: root-causes each item against the local code, cross-references the issue tracker for existing tickets, and separates real bugs from noise instead of reporting raw occurrence counts.

defaultProject.title: Default Rollbar project
defaultProject.description: Project to target when none is given in the arguments. The Rollbar MCP server runs in multi-project mode, so every call needs an explicit project — when this is unset the command asks rather than guessing, since triaging the wrong project silently returns a plausible but irrelevant work list.

defaultEnvironment.title: Default environment
defaultEnvironment.description: Environment to filter items to when none is given. Falls back to production when unset.
